content:
maya: quick question — in the invoke inspector when a tool returns structured output, should the compact card show the tool display name as the primary label or the schema/title from the function definition? attaching screenshot: https://example.com/screen.png

jon: leaning toward schema/title as primary. tool names are often internal (e.g., send_email_v2). users care about the semantic result (InvoiceSummary).

sam: +1 for schema/title. but we should keep the tool name visible as a secondary meta line so users can trace which integration produced it. maybe smaller, muted text.

lisa: accessibility nit: if we rely on color/weight alone to show hierarchy, screen reader users lose context. the card needs an accessible name and role, and the secondary tool name must be programmatically available (aria-describedby or hidden text). also avoid hover-only tooltips — keyboard focus must reveal the same info.

carlos: curious about space constraints — in narrow panes the title can wrap and push the small tool name offscreen. can we truncate tool names and show full on focus? also performance: adding extra DOM nodes per card might matter for huge run histories.

maya: good points. proposal: primary = schema/title (h2 visually, role="heading"), secondary = tool name (muted), both included in accessible name. truncate with ellipsis, on keyboard focus expand a compact popover with full name + copy button.

sam: wording suggestion for secondary line: instead of raw identifier, show humanized name + identifier in parentheses. e.g., "Stripe Invoice Parser (stripe_invoice_v2)". cleaner for non-dev users.

jon: love the humanized name idea. aligns with docs and onboarding. also +1 for copy button — makes debugging easier.

lisa: for the popover, ensure it receives focus and ESC closes. add role="dialog" and aria-modal="false" so screen readers announce it properly. keyboard trap is bad.

carlos: quick implementation sketch — we can use a shared lightweight popover component we've used in the Console. should be fine perf-wise. I'll prototype.

maya: small copy tweak: primary title should be sentence-cased. secondary/tool label should be short: "from: Stripe Invoice Parser" not just raw id.

jon: question: what about run history compact mode? we often collapse cards to single-line. do we keep both labels there or only primary?

sam: compact should keep primary only, with an affordance (chevron) to expand a full card in-place. compact rows are already dense.

lisa: accessibility: ensure the expand control is keyboard reachable and has aria-expanded toggles.

maya: sounds like consensus. action items:
- carlos to prototype compact + expanded card with popover (due Tue)
- sam to produce copy variants for tool humanization and compact label (due Mon)
- lisa to write accessible spec for card/popover interactions (due Mon)
- jon to review UX and QA once proto is up

deploy-bot: note: design branch "invoke-card-a11y" created from maya/design. will auto-deploy preview after commits.

maya: thanks all — I'll file a short doc with screenshots and link it here once carlos has the first prototype. :thumbsup:
